title: Grilled Mackerel Skewers with Japanese Glaze
description: A flavorful and healthy dish that combines the richness of mackerel with the sweetness of a Japanese-inspired glaze, all on a stick.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, and rice vinegar.
Add the grated ginger to the bowl and stir to combine.
Cut the mackerel into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers.
Brush the mackerel with the soy glaze, making sure they're evenly coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the mackerel for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and garnish with green onions.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
